marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Monday.
marine.text:
Wind east 30 knots diminishing to northeast 20 Monday
afternoon. Scattered flurries with a risk of freezing drizzle changing
to snow this evening then to scattered flurries Monday afternoon. Visibility as
low as 1 mile in snow. Temperatures minus 2 falling to minus 13 Monday
evening. Over open water freezing spray. <br/>

afternoon.<br/>
